summary: Navmesh pathfinding for non-grid 3D worlds (Recast/Detour): built from static colliders or triangles, path and nearest-point queries, NavAgent steering.
useWhen: Agents must find their way around free-form 3D geometry (walls at any angle, ramps, decks) rather than a tile grid or authored graph.
limitations: Single solo navmesh, rebuilt whole by build(); no tiled or streamed meshes yet.
Colliders feed it as boxes (balls, capsules, cylinders as bounding boxes); dynamic bodies are ignored.
Grids and graphs should keep mechanics/navigation.
Adds a ~1 MB lazy WASM chunk.
